heading: About the tenancy and your grounds for possession
paragraphs: You will now be asked questions about:
bullets: the date the tenancy or licence began
your grounds for possession (your reasons for making the claim)
afterBullets: You will be asked to upload a copy of the tenancy or licence agreement.
